fields.summary_ko.0: According to a Fortune Business Insights report, the AI-powered storage market is projected to grow from $44.94 billion in 2026 to $271.32 billion in 2034 at a CAGR of 25.2%.
fields.summary_ko.1: Seagate Technology Holdings plc (STX) recorded fiscal Q1 revenue of $4.23 billion (over 60% growth year-over-year), non-GAAP EPS of $7.68, and data center shipments of 198 exabytes.
fields.summary_ko.2: STX expects fiscal Q2 revenue of $4.8 billion (±$100 million, 70% growth year-over-year) and non-GAAP EPS of $9.20 (±20 cents), with HAMR technology roadmap expansion targeting 50% of shipments by year-end.
